page.layout: One page of running text, full width, with the running head at the top and the page number at top right. No marginal notes or footnotes on this page. The left strip is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed. A faint ghost of text below the main text is show-through and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: pugnantes spatium accedendi & recedendi. Vehementius enim cum saltu cursuque tela mittuntur. Ecce in direc-tum, vt ipse ait, siue κατὰ ὠφρασάτην[?] cum Polybio, pedes dat ternos, & in hoc consentiant: inter ordines, id est inter praestites & substites, duplicat & facit sex pedes. Atqui Polybius & hic non nisi ternos. Concilies, quòd Polybius de pugnâ propinquâ & in manibus lo-quitur; Vegetius aspicit magis longinquam, & cùm ia-cula emittuntur. Hic autem plusculo spatio opus: sed postea coëunt & se densant. Semel haec dicta ad univer-sam instructionem sunto: & Imaginem tibi communis huius pugnae pingo, sed ad numeros Polybianos.

page.notes: The Greek word after "κατὰ" is faint and I could not read it letter by letter; it is marked [?]. Printed forms kept as they stand: "quòd", "cùm", "coëunt", "Concilies". Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed hyphens at line ends (direc-, lo-, ia-, univer-) are kept.
